_note: Player names (q(313) ①), read by server/src/p0/accounts/name.ts. A base list to run on (周瑜 11-12); the real one is 李白's, checked by 不知火舞. Words written plainly: the matcher folds case, accents, Cyrillic / Greek look-alikes and 0 1 3 4 5 @ $ itself, lets each letter repeat (fuuuck) and drops spaces and - _ . ' — so write `fuck`, not its spellings. severe: anywhere in the name, inside another word too. words: the whole name or one of its words (as in `Big Ass`, not `Cassandra`). impersonation: the same, for staff-looking names. impersonation_anywhere: anywhere. allow: real words that contain a severe one (Scunthorpe), taken out first. Chinese / Japanese / Korean entries are met anywhere; traditional and simplified are separate entries. A new word needs a server deploy, not a client release.
